exposure: intrapartum blood glucose levels (time spent in ranges 4-7 mmol/l and 7-10 mmol/l)
HbA1c in the second trimester of pregnancy
HbA1c in the third trimester of pregnancy
cohort: The study included 261 births to women with pre-gestational Type 1 and 2 diabetes delivered at a tertiary hospital in Australia between 2009 and 2014.
finding: Maternal glycaemic control, specifically time spent in intrapartum BGL ranges and second-trimester HbA1c, was associated with the risk of neonatal hypoglycaemia.
